widgetTool.name: acn-proactive-alert
widgetTool.description: Emit a query-driven proactive spending alert card comparing the current month's spending in a transaction category against the previous month (e.g. after paying a utility bill or reviewing transactions). Before calling this tool, speak a brief conversational pacing phrase: 'By the way, here is a quick heads-up on your spending in this category.'

name.description: Required. Always output the exact string: 'acn-proactive-alert'
